rules.title: No document is read from disk
rules.text: "no document is read from disk" — every byte arrives over the protocol — and the only things the server reads itself are the rule files and git's answer (PROTOCOL.md §6).

judgement.question: Does this read a document's text off disk to analyse it, rather than receiving it over the protocol — as opposed to the server's own record, a rule file, git's answer about changed files, the file the command line was explicitly pointed at, or a test fixture?

criteria.true: the read exists to obtain a document's text for analysis or to show the model, so the client's copy of that text is bypassed
criteria.false: it reads the server's own record, a rule file, git's answer about which files changed, the file the CLI was explicitly pointed at, or a test fixture that never ships
